item.title: Oil Extends Rally as Stresses Mount Across Global Energy Markets
item.description: Oil extended gains as the US and Israeli war against Iran disrupted crude flows to key importers, with the combatants vowing to press on with the conflict and top importer China seeking to conserve fuel.
